BTC's modest hourly rebound does not establish continuation, and altcoin transmission remains weak. Breadth and capitalization buckets are overlapping proxy evidence, not independent confirmations; unchanged slow inputs are not fresh observations. These are non-binding directional forecasts with no portfolio or execution authority.

Persistent lower prices accompanied by worsening participation, further ETH/BTC weakness and repeated adverse settled flows would resolve the uncertainty toward DOWN.
Any claimed broad rotation would require evidence beyond BTC resilience and isolated Top-100 winners; microcap transmission would remain unknown without its own observations.
